mapper.sql: SELECT a.ics35_extr_activity_id AS extr_activity_id, a.ics35_company_id AS company_id, a.ics35_person_id AS person_id, a.ics35_reg_date AS reg_date, a.ics35_activity_corp AS activity_corp, a.ics35_activity_tgt_cd AS activity_tgt_cd, a.ics35_activity_tgt_etc AS activity_tgt_etc, a.ics35_activity_period AS activity_period, a.ics35_activity_desc AS activity_desc, a.ics35_activity_pay AS activity_pay, a.ics35_appr_id AS appr_id, a.ics35_result_appr_id AS result_appr_id, f_cdnm('ExtrActivityTargetCode', a.ics35_activity_tgt_cd, a.ics35_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS activity_tgt_nm, CASE WHEN ics35_activity_tgt_cd = '90' THEN ics35_activity_tgt_etc ELSE f_cdnm('ExtrActivityTargetCode', a.ics35_activity_tgt_cd, a.ics35_company_id, f_sysdate()) END AS activity_tgt_nm2, b.apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_cd, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, b.apr01_company_id, b.apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_nm, c.apr01_status_cd AS result_appr_status_cd, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', c.apr01_status_cd, c.apr01_company_id, c.apr01_reg_date) AS result_appr_status_nm, d.emp01_kor_nm AS person_nm, d.emp01_emp_no AS person_no, f_get_emptrans(a.ics35_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS org_nm, f_get_empTrans(a.ics35_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'title_nm') AS title_nm, ( SELECT COUNT(*)||'건' FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = a.ics35_extr_activity_id ) AS file_cnt_str, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN STRING_AGG(sys10_file_nm, ', ') ELSE '' END FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = a.ics35_extr_activity_id ) AS file_str FROM ics35_extr_activity a LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr b ON b.apr01_appr_id = a.ics35_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr c ON c.apr01_appr_id = a.ics35_result_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp01_person d ON d.emp01_person_id = a.ics35_person_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics35_extr_activity (ics35_extr_activity_id, ics35_company_id, ics35_person_id, ics35_reg_date, ics35_activity_corp, ics35_activity_tgt_cd, ics35_activity_tgt_etc, ics35_activity_period, ics35_activity_desc, ics35_activity_pay) VALUES (#{req.extrActivityId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{req.regDate}, #{req.activityCorp}, #{req.activityTgtCd}, #{req.activityTgtEtc}, #{req.activityPeriod}, #{req.activityDesc}, #{req.activityPay})
